question.text: SEBI must issue its observations on a draft offer document within how many days?

answer.text: 15 days from the date of receipt
45 days from the date of receipt
60 days from the date of receipt
30 days from the later of receipt, satisfactory reply, regulator clarification, or in-principle approval

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI issues observations within 30 days from the later of: (a) receipt of the draft offer document, (b) receipt of a satisfactory reply from the lead managers to any clarifications sought, (c) receipt of clarifications from any regulator or agency, or (d) receipt of in-principle approval from the stock exchange(s). The Trap: 15, 45, and 60 days are not prescribed. A flat "30 days from receipt" is also incomplete because the 30-day clock starts from whichever of the four triggers occurs last, not from initial filing. Note: Distributor-style pro-tip and cross-exam framing removed; explanation cleaned to source-backed process wording from p.128.
